notes.title: New Build Posted (Joystick Patch +++)
notes.content:
New Build posted...

This patch adds specific joystick detection and binding. A couple things to do to make sure this works as great as possible:

1) Make sure your joystick is connected, and drivers installed before starting the game.

2) Once the game has started, go to Options, Game Settings, Controls, and make sure that the joystick is active and saved. Then, a new row will show up called Joystick Assignment, which will let you check your keys and rebind them if desired. Make sure you are happy with the configuration before continuing.

In addition, lots of menu navigation issues have been fixed with the game. One of the other big issues was that the CP rewards have been significantly raised, and we have improved (hopefully) the easiness of some of the earlier missions, and fly patrol specifically,

Please let us know what you think, and give us a nice review if you like the update. Great reviews insure future updates - they really do help.

Thank you for your patience and understanding with this long process - our aim has always been to create a game that is solid and fun.

And if you have a second, please check out our new game set in the same 'verse, Starlight Tactics, which will be launching on Steam tomorrow, 04.07.2015.

Kindest Regards,
Garry and the Starlight Inception Team

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Starlight Inception™
notes.content:
Starlight Inception™ is Now Available on Steam!

One hundred years from tomorrow...World War IV has started! Do you have what it takes to join the United Star Force and defend Earth and its colonies from the relentless marauders of the Non-Aligned Nations? With a complement of over thirty spacefighters, bombers and transports with customizable weapons and equipment at your disposal, can you take the fight to the enemy and win back the Star System in the name of freedom? Assume the role of a young space fighter pilot assigned to the star carrier U.S.F. Midway (SCVN-41), deploy to hotspots throughout the inner and outer planets and win the last great World War!

STARLIGHT INCEPTION is a relevant first person / third person space combat experience with elements of exploration. It has a unique blend of action with an involving storyline. Features include ship based combat both in space and on planets and moons, interplanetary exploration, and multiplayer dogfighting.

LIGHT UP THE SKY...in the return of the space simulation genre.

notes.title: New Patch posted...leading up to transition from Early Access to Full Release
notes.content:
This patch addresses the dreaded startup bug as well as the quality of the lighting on lower end systems with Dynamic Lights set to "deactivated". We have also addressed several bugs in single, multiplayer and splitscreen (local multiplayer) modes. Please let us know if there are any issues which come up.

We are agressively moving toward full release (look for a release candidate within the next coulple weeks).

Thank you for your patience and understanding with this long process - our aim has always been to create a game that was solid and fun.

Kindest Regards,
Garry

notes.title: Version Beta 0.4.0 posted (adds Multiplayer Online and Local, Russian Language and more...)
notes.content:
Beta v 0.4.0 is live - we've fixed a lot of bugs, and added a few more for you to find -

- Multiplayer Online (through Steam) and Multiplayer Local (Splitscreen) implemented [sixteen players max for Online, four players max for splitscreen]
- Localized text added for Russian language.
- HUD art and functionality enhancements
- Cines improved
- Lots of bug fixes, including many blocker bugs in levels, equipment configuration bugs, progression bugs, save bugs, and others


We are marching toward a full release, so please let us know what bugs still exist in the game.

Planned for the next release:

More specific joystick support
More refinement of mouse/keyboard interface
Multiplayer tweaks and enhancements.
More bug fixes and improvements

Thank you for supporting this game and for believing in our vision. We hope you enjoy this latest build.

notes.title: Beta v 0.3.0 is live!!! (Giant Update)
notes.content:
Build Notes attached... Beta v 0.3.0 is live - we've fixed a lot of bugs, and added a few more for you to find -

- Localized text available for French, Italian, German and Spanish. (Russian is planned for the next build)
- Professional voice actors for all lines in the game
- HUD art and functionality enhancements
- Cines improved
- Lots of bug fixes, including many blocker bugs in levels, equipment configuration bugs, progression bugs, save bugs, and others
- Altitude and Attitude display works on all planets and moons
- End Credits screen completed
- Pause menu added to Interactive Midway environment
- More skippable cines
- Tactical partners fully integrated, with specific voice

We are marching toward a full release in early January, so please let us know what bugs still exist in the game.

Planned for the next release:

More specific joystick support
More refinement of mouse/keyboard interface
Online Multiplayer functionality
More sound effects and voicelines (especially in between missions)
More bug fixes and improvements

Thank you for supporting this game and for believing in our vision. We hope you enjoy this latest build.

Kindest Regards,
Garry and the Starlight Inception Team

notes.title: BETA 0.2.0 RELEASED (HUGE UPDATE)!!!
notes.content:
Beta Version 0.2.0 posted!

- All Single Player Campaign Missions live
- All SIngle Player Fly Patrol Missions live
- All Multiplayer Splitscreen Missions live
- All ships and equipment are selectable in Hangar Bay
- Between mission 1st person mode on carrier/litteral ship live
- Music integrated for all mission modes
- All video cinematics are integrated
- Mission progression should hold missions and purchased ships
- Mission redeploy available for Campaign and Fly Patrol
- Joystick support for Saitek x52, Logitech Extreme 3D, Thrustmaster HOTAS, and generic support as well
- Some (very few) actor voicelines integrated - many more coming
- Enemy fighters are selectable as player fighters in Splitscreen
- Mouse functionality expanded - more clickable items 
- Lighting adjustments
- Targetting mode tightened
- Music manager integrated
- Power Wheel bugs fixed
- "L" launches ship now
- Added ability to skip briefings
- Mission Outcome bugs fixed
- Icon help for joysticks
- Fixed several splitscreen bugs
- Mouse and keyboard use in Splitscreen removed for now

notes.title: Huge Update planned for November 1st
notes.content:
There is a huge update planned for November 1st, (or shortly after if we find last second issues).

Expect the rest of the missions (both single player and fly patrol), the rest of the fighters available, all of the multiplayer splitscreen missions, the carrier 1st person stuff and lots of bug fixes (including the joysticks) - basically everything promised, with exceptions, but still in beta state, which means there will be bugs present.

Exceptions - 

1) We are still integrating the Steam code to enable multiplayer
2) Still placeholder voices for a little while longer - we're waiting for the professional voice acting replacements
3) Some cinematics are placeholder
